manufacturer.name: Wiśniowski
manufacturer.note: Polish garage, industrial and gate door manufacturer. It serves documents from two of its own shop domains - sklep.wisniowski.pl and obchod.wisniowski.eu - rather than from a documentation index, and no index surfaced, so supportUrl stays null while both shop directories are registered as harvest targets.
